descriptionChirho: The noun nachat I denoting rest, quietness, or tranquility -- a state of peaceful repose or calm. All four clusters express the same concept with only grammatical variation: absolute form (S117351, 4x), with preposition be- 'in quietness' (S117352), with conjunction waw 'and rest' (S117353), and construct form 'rest-of' (S117354). Multilingual evidence uniformly confirms a single sense: eng 'rest/quietness', spa 'descanso/reposo/quietud', hin 'shanti/vishram/aram' (शान्ति/विश्राम/आराम), arb 'rahah/sukun' (رَاحَةٌ/السُّكُونِ), kor 'pyeong-an/swim' (평안/쉼), swa 'pumziko/utulivu'. These are all semantically equivalent expressions of peaceful repose.
